title: APOLO: Automatic Prompt Optimization for Ontology Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.34540v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Ontology Learning (OL) from text has advanced with the emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs), but it remains challenging due to the limited availability of annotated training data and the difficulty of adapting LLMs to perform OL effectively. We address this via APOLO - Automatic Prompt Optimization for Ontology Learning, by casting OL as an explicit prompt optimization problem over LLM modules. To obtain training data, we employ a multi-agent system that generates text-ontology pairs from existing expert-curated ontologies. We then propose two ontology learner architectures: a greedy and an autoregressive learner, and optimize both using GEPA, a greedy evolutionary prompt optimizer built on DSPy. Experiments on two ontologies - a biomedical (DOID) and a plant ontology (PO) show consistent improvements after optimization across nearly all model and mode combinations, with autoregressive learners achieving the largest gains. tldr: 提出 APOLO 框架，将本体学习转化为大语言模型模块上的显式提示优化问题，利用多智能体系统从专家本体生成训练数据，并用 GEPA 进化提示优化器优化贪心与自回归两种学习器，在生物医学和植物本体任务上实现近乎全面的一致性能提升。
en_tdlr: APOLO casts ontology learning as an explicit prompt optimization problem over LLM modules, using a multi-agent system to generate text-ontology training pairs from expert-curated ontologies and the GEPA evolutionary prompt optimizer to tune greedy and autoregressive learners, yielding consistent improvements across biomedical and plant ontology tasks.
